dedupe_keys.name: 名古屋市 高潮ハサートマッフ storm surge and coastal flooding and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 【名古屋市】高潮ハザードマップ [storm surge and coastal flooding and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 愛知県が令和３年６月に公表した、高潮浸水想定区域図を基に作成しています。 日本に上陸した既往最大台風である室戸台風規模の気圧を有する台風が、満潮時に三河湾・伊勢湾岸に最も大きな影響を与える経路を通過することに伴う高潮により氾濫が発生した場合に想定される浸水区域、浸水深をシミュレーションにより算出したものです。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 名古屋市, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
